component.name: MaxTubePlus
component.summary: YouTube client with advanced search, creator bans and DeArrow

description.p: A native desktop counterpart to the MaxTubePlus iOS tweak, sharing its filtering and matching code.

ul.li: Advanced search: duration range, minimum likes, upload date and recency, flexible dates, topics and #tags, loose names
Background downloads with pause, resume, retry and recovery
Search your YouTube comments from a Google Takeout export
Local subscriptions without a Google account
